mob: # The map figures of the first mobs, redone on 2026-11-22 so that they look like their battle sprites (assets/sprites/enemy_gobelin.png,
# _brute.png, _chaman.png): the old ones came from the first generator and the shaman's robe, the brute's armour and the goblin's head
# were not the same character. Built by tools/make_mobs.py into assets/sprites/iso/unit_<mob>.png ('iso.unit.<mob>').
# create_character, mode v3 (from text), view low top-down, 8 directions, then animate_character with the template 'walking' (6 frames a
# direction, 8 generations). The ZIP of each character is unpacked into tools/mobs/raw/<mob>/unit/ (Idle/rotations -> rotations,
# Idle/animations/walk -> walk), after erasing the stray pixels PixelLab left away from the figure: whatever is not the figure's largest

# blob nor within 2 pixels of it (second tries: gobelin and brute; the counts, with the shaman's, were gobelin 0, brute 10, chaman 1 on the first tries). The template loses what is held in the hand in some views while walking
# (a little of the goblin's dagger in the back views, the brute's club to the north-east, the shaman's staff to the west): it is back in the standing frame.
# Every request ended with "Small map unit seen from far away, bold readable shape, strong (saturated, for the second tries) colours, only the figure on an empty background,
# no ground shadow, no icon or emblem beside it".
